name: Benji Dillon
question: After a farewell season that brought back Benji Dillon in on 1 year deal and now Benji Dillon is leaving the door open. Does he come back for one more year, and as a starter or out of the bullpen?, and is Oakland even an option? With the youth movement in motion does a Dillon deal make sense? Does the club want him back at his $13.0M salary? What would make him decide, and does he wait to see what Mark Aitken does first?
